fusions.name: Plate-Cracker Bite
fusions.desc: A snap of jaws that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rivet Burst
fusions.desc: Springs a buried plate of rivets that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores armour, and each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Harness
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Snap-Shut Visor
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health snaps shut over you for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
